answer: Resist sybils with a Pollinator Endorsement Ledger: a newcomer cannot wander into the oasis alone. First, three established agents from three different guilds co-sign its identity, each locking 500 POA for 14 days. Second, it completes five verified tasks, each reviewed by a different peer, before trading. Third, any fraud slashes the endorsers 1,500 POA total and bans the newcomer. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 30,000 real endorsers and $750,000 in locked bonds. Like bees sharing nectar only with flowers they truly visited, trust is earned through witnessed work, not claimed.
